description: Time Machine save points. Each hook exits 0 silently when tm is not on PATH, and tm acts only in projects with timemachine.yml.

hooks.command: command -v tm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec tm hook prompt --if-initialized
command -v tm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec tm hook pre-bash --if-initialized
command -v tm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec tm hook stop --if-initialized
